name: Relentless Juggernaut

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The juggernaut regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Unstoppable Force
entries: The juggernaut ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The juggernaut makes two Executioner's Blade attacks.

action.name: Executioner's Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Devastating Spin {@recharge 4}
entries: The juggernaut spins its blade. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 ({@damage 8d10}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half on a success.

fluffEntries: **O Carrasco da Casa:** guarda o piso alagado do altar. Versão FATAL: entra no combate no round 1 e a Devastating Spin recarrega em 4–6.
